note: Roles, dates and titles match LinkedIn. Bullets are the proof, newest work first; each number is Elliot's own and cross-checked with /built. Each row renders whatever fields are filled; dates and titles are optional.

bullets: Led product and a squad of six engineers. The AI STEM tutor went from first commit to the App Store in under a month and reached 10,000 students, 47% of monthly users back every week.

Marking evals took accuracy from a 67% bare-model baseline to over 99% against official mark schemes, and the DfE picked the tutor for its AI Tutoring Tools Pioneers Programme, 2nd of eight with a £300k grant.
Took the school hub to 850+ UK schools: 91% of students activate when their teacher rolls it out, against 23% on self-signup.
Joined as employee #4 and built the operation as we grew to 40. Did ISO 27001 and 9001 solo as DPO, which unlocked our first FTSE 100 contracts, and ran the revenue ops behind £1.5m ARR.
Built support around an AI assistant that resolved 91% of conversations and halved weekly support time with no dedicated hire. CSAT 84%, NPS 80+.
Lifted mentee-to-mentor conversion from 6% to 40%, keeping 120,000 students on one platform from school to university.

paras: Elliot is the ultimate startup operator — a genuine Swiss Army knife who has made an impact across customer success, operations and product at Zero Gravity.

He doesn't just understand what AI makes possible; he builds with it, experiments rapidly and ships. He now contributes as many PRs as some of our senior engineers, while bringing the customer insight and commercial judgement you would expect from a strong product leader.
If I were starting another business tomorrow, Elliot would be one of the first people I'd try to hire.
quote.name: Joe Seddon

bullets: Led product and operations for the probate service, between customers, legal specialists and the case team.
Cut case-agent errors 69% and case handling from two weeks to four days, with guided intake, case tracking and integrations with HMCTS, HMRC and the banks.
Fixed the input errors that took 30% of solicitor time, so two solicitors could do what had needed five. NPS went from 20 to 80+.
Wrote the vulnerable-customer framework the whole company adopted.
Co-founded a volunteer-run charity in the first COVID wave. Day 1 was a WhatsApp group; day 10 was a four-sided marketplace in production.
Delivered 303,000 meals in 100 days across 146 hospitals and 223 restaurants, 97% on time, and raised £1.8m.
Grew the volunteer team from 6 to 120 with a hiring playbook other leads could run.
Built CX and crisis operations from nothing: no CRM, no ticketing and no supplier contracts when I joined.
Held NPS above 90 through 400% year-on-year growth and the US launch, which hit its 12-week plan on the day.
Hired and trained the first 15 ops staff and tripled the international partner network.
Kept a 100% safety record through the Sri Lanka attacks and COVID closures.
